title: halimium halimifolium var. planifolium
intro: Halimium halimifolium var. planifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Cistaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Halimium halimifolium var. planifolium include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and irritation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
